column1: # companions.tsv: the tools that Shipinetics uses with its own skills. One row for each companion,
#   name  kind (skill, plugin or cli)  id  level (required or optional)  why  install  skillspector
# id: the skill folder name, plugin@marketplace, or the command name. No field is empty.
# shipinetics-companions, the session-start notice, setup and the README read this file.
# SkillSpector results: SkillSpector 2.12.0, static mode (--no-llm), 2026-10-28. The README lists
# the version of each companion that was scanned. Scan again before you install a newer version.

column5: Asks you about each decision in a plan, one at a time, with a recommended answer. Shipinetics uses it before a spec, and before each decision that is hard to reverse.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill grilling -g -a claude-code
column7: SAFE. 1 MEDIUM finding, a keyword match: "don't ask the user" is about facts that the agent finds itself.

column5: Keeps the glossary (GLOSSARY.md) and the decision records (docs/adr/). Shipinetics uses it together with grilling.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill domain-modeling -g -a claude-code
column7: CAUTION. No findings. The analysis is partial because the skill names files that it writes later.

column5: When a message from the agent is not clear, type /wait-what. The agent explains it again, more simply, in ASD-STE100.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill wait-what -g -a claude-code
column7: CAUTION. No findings. The analysis is partial because the skill names a project file that it reads.

column5: Finds facts in primary sources (official docs, API limits, versions) and writes them to a file. Shipinetics uses it when a task depends on external facts.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill research -g -a claude-code

column5: Builds a small throwaway prototype to answer one design question, such as a state model or a screen. Shipinetics uses it before a spec.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill prototype -g -a claude-code

column5: Gives the words and rules to design modules and their interfaces. Shipinetics uses it when a change needs a new module or seam.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill codebase-design -g -a claude-code

column5: A loop that finds the cause of a hard bug or a slow path. Shipinetics uses it for bug fixes. Test-writer writes the regression test.
column6: npx skills add mattpocock/skills --skill diagnosing-bugs -g -a claude-code
column7: CAUTION. 1 HIGH finding, a keyword match: "show instruction" in a comment of a script template.

column5: Cloudflare's security review. The security reviewer uses it for each change that touches security, and the full security audit uses it on your schedule.
column7: DO_NOT_INSTALL in static mode. All 10 HIGH findings are false positives: credential file names in a security checklist, /etc/passwd in tests that reject unsafe paths, and 4 files that the scan read only in part. Checked by hand.

column5: Grades each PR as low, medium or high risk, and names the files that cause the grade. The grade tells you how carefully to review.
column6: npx skills add warpdotdev/common-skills --skill merge-risk -g -a claude-code

column5: Design review and design checks. The UI reviewer, design-check and the design-system setup use it. Install the plugin, not the npx skills copy.
column6: claude plugin marketplace add pbakaus/impeccable && claude plugin install impeccable@impeccable
column7: DO_NOT_INSTALL in static mode. All 6 HIGH findings are false positives: phrases such as "Never judge fidelity from one thumbnail" and "without warning" in design guidance. Checked by hand.

column5: Shows changes and systems to you on a whiteboard, for reviews and explanations. Without it, the agent uses Mermaid diagrams. It also needs the dev.fast Whiteboard app.
column6: claude plugin marketplace add devdotfast/whiteboard && claude plugin install whiteboard@devfast
column7: SAFE for the plugin. The plugin only starts the Whiteboard app (~/.local/bin/whiteboard), and SkillSpector does not scan the app.

column5: NVIDIA's scanner for skills, plugins and MCP servers. scan-skills and the install gate use it. Scan each companion with it before you install it.
column7: Not scanned: it is the scanner.

column5: Security tests of your running app. It runs only after you approve each run. It needs Docker (running) and an LLM provider key in your vault.
column7: Not scanned: it is a CLI, not a skill.
